cases.name: CHK-001 happy: help and direct CLI expose gap commands
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const help = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'help'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); const convergence = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'convergence_check'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); return { helpHasGap: help.includes('gap_analyze') && help.includes('convergence_check'), runsDirectly: convergence.includes('converged') && !convergence.includes('未知命令') };

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: gap_analyze keeps structured output
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const raw = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'gap_analyze'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); const json = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); return { hasCoveragePercent: typeof json.coveragePercent === 'number', hasGapsArray: Array.isArray(json.gaps) };

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: convergence_check is wired to a real handler
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const raw = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'convergence_check'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); return { noHandlerError: !raw.includes('handler not found') && !raw.includes('未知命令'), hasChecks: Array.isArray(JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))).checks) };

cases.name: CHK-002 happy: verifier script checks help and execution together
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const out = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/scripts/verify-gap-cli-commands.mjs'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); return { verified: out.includes('gap CLI commands verified') };

cases.name: CHK-002 edge: help shows Gap group in default CLI
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const help = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'help'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); return { hasGapGroup: help.includes('Gap:'), hasGapAnalyze: help.includes('gap_analyze'), hasConvergence: help.includes('convergence_check') };

cases.name: CHK-002 adversarial: regression script would fail if tools disappear again
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const out = execFileSync('npm', ['run', 'test:gap-cli'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); return { scriptPassed: out.includes('gap CLI commands verified') };
